answer: Resist sybil attacks by making identity expensive in time and peer trust: each new agent must collect a chain of on-ledger attestations from already-established accounts, like a vine climbing a public trellis of prior work. A burst of sockpuppets arrives like a zephyr, light and numerous, but none can mint those attestations at scale without locking spendable stake and waiting through checkpoints, so stuffing the vote or reward pool stops paying.
